content.comment_body: Hello, We are experiencing issues connecting to our [product_name] devices, which we've finally traced to recent browser security updates. Here is a link to my previous discussion, including another user's explanation of the issue. [url] The problem arises because updated browsers like Edge and Chrome enforce stricter security protocols, and [product_name] devices respond with protocol errors. The root cause is the device firmware's handling of the extended 'Hello' packet during the TLS handshake. While other legacy systems manage this packet correctly, these devices encounter failures. Resolving this will require [company_name] to update the TLS handling within the firmware. Is [company_name] working on a fix, and do we have an expected timeline? Disabling new browser security features is only a temporary workaround, and major companies like Microsoft and Google plan to make these changes mandatory soon. Thank you, [user_name] [url] [url]

If you are looking for a response from [company_name], you will need to contact them directly. This forum is a user-driven platform provided and moderated by [company_name]. You can reach their technical support through a formal Support Request.

Thank you, but when I try to submit a support ticket, the system suggests using the forums instead. "As an alternative to Technical Support Services, free support for [product_name] is available through the Technical Forum. There you can connect with both technical support specialists and the community." Is this accurate?

I cannot clarify exactly what [company_name] means by this statement. This forum is designed for user interaction and is moderated by [company_name], but most participants are not employees. Some questions can be answered here by knowledgeable users who volunteer their support. There is an account called "[product_name] Support" that represents [company_name] staff, but they typically respond only when official support is requested. Alternatively, you can initiate a support request, which is free at first. If your issue requires further assistance beyond the initial level, additional support may be offered for a fee, but the support team will ask whether you wish to continue with paid help.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing SSL/TLS errors when accessing [product_name] devices via modern browsers due to incomplete support for extended Hello packets in the TLS handshake. Other legacy systems from different vendors are unaffected, but these devices fail to connect. Users are looking for confirmation and updates from [company_name] about upcoming firmware changes to resolve compatibility issues with stricter browser security protocols.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [company_name] to release a firmware update for [product_name] devices, ensuring they remain compatible with current browser security standards and preventing future connection issues related to security protocols.
